We’re thrilled to announce that Intel is now the Official Compute Partner of @mclarenracing. ​

Intel will deliver advanced computing for data and AI, powering how the team prepares, predicts, optimizes, and competes at every turn. ​

From factory to circuit, advanced computing and engineering turn complex challenges into advantages at every turn. ​

To learn more: https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/customer-spotlight/stories/mclaren-racing.html

#McLaren #Intel #AI 
 
Subscribe now to Intel on YouTube: https://intel.ly/3IX1bN2 
 
About Intel:
Intel, the world leader in silicon innovation, develops technologies, products and initiatives to continually advance how people work and live. Founded in 1968 to build semiconductor memory products, Intel introduced the world's first microprocessor in 1971. This decade, our mission is to create and extend computing technology to connect and enrich the lives of every person on Earth.
